experimental_design: Comparative proteomics of chitinase-containing complexes across P. gallinaceum, P. falciparum, and transgenic P. berghei lines

Mass spectrometry analysis was carried out directly on the affinity pull-down chitin beads to identify the proteins present in the high molecular weight chitinase complex in both P. gallinaceum... and P. falciparum...
